description: Reference thermal performance data for Ladakh earthen shelter, derived from published field measurements (Leh, 3500m ASL)
sources: Jain, D. (2006). Modeling of solar passive techniques for roof cooling in arid regions. Building and Environment.
Kaushik, S.C. et al. (2014). Thermal performance of mud-brick earthen shelter in cold arid Leh.
